headline: MTN MoMo Revenue Jumps 102% as Wallet Balances Reach N43.8 Billion
summary: MTN Nigeria's mobile money business recorded a 102.2% increase in revenue for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, with customer wallet balances quadrupling to N43.8 billion.
why: Mobile money growth serves as a key performance indicator for telecommunications fintech expansion and consumer adoption in emerging markets.

impacts.name: MTN Nigeria Communications Plc
impacts.why: Substantial revenue and wallet balance growth directly improve fintech segment earnings.
